reviewed_existing_lane.title: Trigger 4: WP002 G5 aggregate state projection repair
reviewed_existing_lane.scope: metadata projection/state consistency only; runtime credit zero

existing_lane_already_covers: STATE.json treated as a cache/projection rather than an authority oracle
terminal pointer -> exact matching reconciliation checks
explicit broader_workpackage_status handling for scoped acceptance
append-only reconciliation-chain validation with parent links and unique leaf
pull-request CI coverage for state-consistency drift
duplicate_intent_retired: Do not create a second WP002 aggregate-projection implementation lane and do not promote the broad E2 proposal as a separate E5 candidate.

genuinely_missing_or_unproven_in_pr115.observation: PR115's test computes required repairs and the validator rejects inconsistent STATE, but the reviewed surfaces still treat STATE.json as a manually materialized file; no pure canonical builder/write-check pair was observed that can reconstruct the entire view from granular inputs.
genuinely_missing_or_unproven_in_pr115.why_it_matters: External materialized-view guidance treats the view as disposable and rebuildable from source. Validation alone detects drift after it exists; a deterministic builder removes independent manual projection semantics.

genuinely_missing_or_unproven_in_pr115.observation: The v1 contract exposes one scalar state value. PR115 maps an ACTIVE current pointer to IN_PROGRESS. It does not expose a structured field for highest_accepted_generation/accepted_scopes from historical terminal reconciliations while a newer generation is active.
genuinely_missing_or_unproven_in_pr115.why_it_matters: One scalar cannot simultaneously say 'generation N accepted at scope S' and 'generation N+1 is active'. The accepted scope remains evidence but is not queryable as first-class aggregate state.

genuinely_missing_or_unproven_in_pr115.observation: The reviewed v1 consistency contract has no projector code digest, projection schema/version, deterministic input-manifest digest, input count or last processed evidence identity.
genuinely_missing_or_unproven_in_pr115.why_it_matters: A self-consistent stale projection needs an explicit identity/freshness witness; current repo HEAD alone is too coarse because unrelated commits should not change semantic projection content.

genuinely_missing_or_unproven_in_pr115.observation: PR115 explicitly validates machine STATE.json surfaces; no reviewed mechanism mechanically renders/verifies WORKPACKAGES.md status markers from the same canonical projection result.
genuinely_missing_or_unproven_in_pr115.why_it_matters: A human ledger and machine ledger maintained independently can drift even if one of them is internally valid.

recommended_nonduplicate_delta_to_existi.lane: PR115 or its exact-current successor after rebase/reentry
changes: Factor the existing pointer/reconciliation precedence logic into a pure deterministic build_projection(root) function.
Add --check mode that canonicalizes and compares the generated projection with checked-in STATE; optionally add --write for explicit maintenance, never runtime truth mutation.
Add projection_meta with projector_schema_version, projector_code_digest and canonical input_manifest_digest; exclude volatile display timestamps from the canonical digest.

Extend per-workpackage machine shape compatibly (or version schema deliberately) with current_generation/current_generation_state plus highest_accepted_generation/accepted_scopes; do not infer runtime credit from either.
Add a fixture: G1 ACCEPTED_AT_SCOPE followed by G2 ACTIVE must project current_generation_state=IN_PROGRESS while preserving G1 accepted scope.
Add a contradictory same-generation fixture that fails closed instead of latest-file-wins.
Mechanically verify or render WORKPACKAGES.md status markers from the same projection output, while leaving descriptive prose human-maintained.
Preserve PR115's reconciliation-chain and explicit whole-system-zero checks unchanged.

architecture_assessment.authority_change: NONE; projection remains derived cache only
architecture_assessment.expected_coordination_benefit: reduces recurring aggregate drift and duplicate routing without adding runtime cognition cost
architecture_assessment.evidence_scope: E2 architecture review only; no executable acceptance

counterhypothesis: PR115 validation-only design may be intentionally sufficient; if a deterministic builder adds maintenance complexity and drift does not recur after PR115 merges, the builder portion should be omitted while the multi-generation fixture/metadata gap is reconsidered separately.
falsifier: After PR115 or successor is rebased on exact current main, demonstrate that (a) STATE can be reconstructed byte-equivalently from granular evidence with existing code, (b) accepted G1 + active G2 is represented losslessly in machine aggregate state, and (c) WORKPACKAGES.md cannot drift independently. If all three already hold, this residual delta is obsolete.
next_exact_action: Emit one Trigger-4 review handoff targeting PR115/successor; do not create a new E5 implementation candidate.
